descriptions.notStarted: As the Mountain God said, if I got an axe from Dark Axestump, let's go to the Mountain God and ask him to see if it's indeed the steel axe.
descriptions.inProgress: The Mountain God told me if I bring the #baxe#k that #r#o2130100##k had, then he'll look into it and see if it's indeed the steel axe of the tree cutter or not. I need to pick up an axe from Dark Stump and bring it back to the Mountain God.
descriptions.completed: The Mountain God carefully looked through the axe that I picked up, and told me what kind of axe that was. If I ever find the tree cutter's steel axe, then I'll have to return it to the tree cutter who lives somewhere around the Black Mountain.
